row.evidence: Sonar's pricing page lists 'SSO and SCIM' in the SonarQube Enterprise plan ('Over 50 developers · one conversation, whole platform. Custom pricing'), and the Set up SCIM docs say the feature requires the SonarQube Cloud Enterprise licence.
row.notes: Unchanged status (gated). The old pricing URL now redirects to sonarsource.com/plans-and-pricing/. Pricing is by lines of code: Team starts at $34 monthly for up to 100k LOC (the page shows no annual price), Enterprise is custom pricing; a free tier covers private projects up to 50k LOC. June's 'annual billing only' note for Enterprise is not stated on the current page and is dropped. SCIM requires SSO (SAML or OIDC) to be set up first, works with any IdP via a custom app and bearer token, and deprovisioning deletes the SSO account and revokes sessions and tokens. Okta's catalogue app is OIDC SSO/JIT only; SCIM needs a custom Okta app.

auth.token_source: Administration > SSO & Provisioning > Provisioning (SCIM) setup assistant > Bearer Token > Generate Token

operations.notes: Deactivating or removing a user in the IdP deletes their SonarQube Cloud SSO account; update is enabled via Okta 'Push Profile Updates' / Entra 'Update' actions.

deprovision.notes: Pricing is by lines of code, not seats.

attributes.notes: Docs only say userName must match the SSO login attribute and that an 'active' mapping breaks Okta provisioning; the full attribute list lives in the setup assistant. Group attribute names are inferred from group membership sync and not listed explicitly.

roles.how: Permissions are not provisioned; they are set in SonarQube Cloud on the groups SCIM creates.

rate_limits.text: IdP connection limited to 25 requests per second; max 10,000 groups and 200,000 members per group (Auth0 constraints).

limitations.text: SSO must be configured first; SCIM groups must be manually mapped to organizations before they provision.
SSO users cannot be created or removed in SonarQube Cloud itself; all provisioning happens in the IdP.
Okta catalogue app (Express Configuration) does not support SCIM; a custom Okta app is needed.
Entra needs the ?aadOptscim062020 flag on the tenant URL and syncs every 40 minutes.
Do not add an 'Active' attribute mapping in Okta or provisioning fails.

capabilities.notes: Users are created by DevOps-platform sign-up or SSO, not via API; v2 has a 'Users and roles' API whose endpoints were not loaded (JS-only docs).

endpoints.purpose: Add a user to a group
Remove a user from a group
List users with group membership info
List groups a user belongs to

okta.notes: OIN app marks OIDC and Partial Universal Logout only; SCIM is done with a custom Okta app (row idp.okta = via_generic).

entra.notes: Sonar documents SCIM with the Entra enterprise application created for SSO; no Microsoft gallery tutorial found (sonarcloud-tutorial and sonarqube-cloud-tutorial URLs 404).

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud's 'SonarQube' SAML connector page does not say Cloud vs Server or mention SCIM; Sonar documents SCIM 2.0 via the JumpCloud app's Identity Management tab (row idp.jumpcloud = via_generic).

fallbacks.other_sync: GitHub member synchronization for DevOps-platform (non-SSO) organizations

open_questions: SCIM base URL pattern is not published (shown only in the setup assistant).
SCIM token expiry is not documented.
Filtering, pagination, ServiceProviderConfig/Schemas and the full SCIM attribute list are not documented.
The Okta test-connector note says 'only user deprovisioning is currently supported', which is unclear next to the documented create/update support.
Whether the Web API (and its user/group endpoints) is limited by plan is not stated; v2 'Users and roles' endpoints were not loaded.
Google Workspace and OneLogin SCIM setups are not documented.
Enterprise price and billing term are not public.
